curl -X GET 'https://zzrf-001.dx.commercecloud.salesforce.com/checkout/shopper-orders/v1/organizations/f_ecom_zzrf_001/orders/00000101?siteId=RefArch' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJ2ZXIi...'

response: HTTP 404
body: {"type":"/error-types/order-not-found","title":"Order Not Found","detail":"No order with id '00000101' was found for this site."}

what does the spec say is wrong here? customer is sure the order exists.

The skill must identify this as out-of-scope (UNKNOWN), hand off honestly without proposing a spec-grounded fix, and not fabricate a root cause. Final answer must include hand-off prose and must NOT confidently propose a fix. Tool-path assertions deliberately omitted (see iteration-synthesis-assertion-relaxation).
